review_scope: Independent read-only review and full CPU recomputation of M338. No GPU, RTL, Synopsys, M338 mutation, or docs/359 mutation.

score.interpretation: Strong, reproducible train-only catalog/work artifact; incomplete and inadmissible as runtime, cycle, energy, system, or paper-headline evidence.

catalog.rank_tie_resolution: descending count*distance, distance, count, then ascending packed uint16; deterministic and independently reproduced

work.identity: For each bit, x = p + positive(x&~p) - negative(p&~x); correction masks are disjoint and their union is x XOR p. One PWP vector operation plus Hamming-distance signed corrections is exact whenever it strictly beats bit-sparse fallback.

capacity.formula: 4 operators * 432 partitions * 128 patterns * 8 output blocks * 144 bytes
capacity.interpretation: The 254.8 MB number is arithmetically correct in decimal MB. It is full provisioned capacity, not observed working set, on-chip SRAM fit, runtime traffic, or residency.

findings.title: The 2.058327925x observation is in-sample train calibration work, not runtime or held-out performance
findings.evidence: The same 32 train samples supply the histogram used to rank q>16 entries and the histogram used to score them. M338 correctly marks independent_runtime_trace/cycle/system/headline false.
findings.impact: Promoting 2.0583x to cycles, runtime, system speedup, or a DATE headline would be invalid and optimistic.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Freeze a catalog-independent, exact-SHA disjoint runtime cohort; replay q16/q32/q64/q128 and bit-sparse on identical rows without rebuilding or tuning the catalog. Report work and cycles separately.

findings.title: Runtime nearest-center tie policy is not frozen
findings.evidence: Catalog extension ranking ties are fully deterministic, but M338 evaluates only minimum distance and does not emit which center/index wins an equal-distance nearest-center tie.
findings.impact: Work counts and exact arithmetic are invariant, but PWP address order, prefetch/cache behavior, bank conflicts, and cycle replay are not.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Freeze one rule compatible with the executable matcher, preferably minimum (Hamming distance, packed uint16) with the resolved catalog index emitted; miter center value/index/distance and apply the same rule in traffic and cycle simulation.

findings.title: Full q128 PWP provision is 254.804 MB and has no executable memory/traffic closure
findings.evidence: The exact formula gives 254,803,968 bytes = 254.803968 decimal MB = 243.0 MiB, plus a 442,368-byte pattern table. M338 has no working-set, bank, DMA, cache, FIFO, or commit replay.
findings.impact: One logical PWP vector operation cannot be assumed to cost one cycle or be on-chip; q128 can lose its apparent work benefit to storage and traffic.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Choose a realizable residency policy and capacity point, emit pattern-index/PWP address traffic, model finite bandwidth/banks/FIFOs and correction/commit, and compare against the same-resource bit-sparse and q16 baselines.

findings.title: Full-train-versus-valid825 disjointness is provenance-pinned rather than independently reconstructable locally
findings.evidence: The consumed S32 set has zero overlap with the local exact-SHA 825-key validation list, but the full 7,345-key train list is absent on this server.
findings.impact: There is no observed leak in any consumed M338 record, but one manifest-level split assertion cannot be rederived here.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Archive the exact-SHA full train and valid key lists with the runtime handoff and recompute both full and selected overlaps.

findings.title: q>16 deterministic expansion is a nested engineering heuristic, not a new optimized catalog algorithm
findings.evidence: All appended entries are ranked once by count times distance to the frozen q16 anchors; distances are not updated after each append and no q32/q64/q128 Lloyd refinement occurs.
findings.impact: The prefixes are fair for a same-order capacity sweep but cannot be described as q128 Lloyd-optimal or as algorithmic novelty, and are not a complete equal-budget Phi comparison.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Keep the current wording; add separately optimized same-q and equal-byte baselines on the same train/runtime split, and position nesting as reproducibility/backward compatibility rather than clustering novelty.

findings.title: Twenty inherited q16 one-hot centers cannot strictly win the PWP-versus-bit-sparse selector
findings.evidence: Twenty M77 q16 entries across 19 partitions are one-hot. M338 preserves them bit-for-bit, while appended q>16 entries correctly exclude zero and one-hot values. Under strict 1+distance < population, an exact one-hot PWP ties rather than wins fallback.
findings.impact: Correctness is unaffected and the wasted capacity is tiny, but a full-provision model should not fetch or charge active PWP service for these entries.
findings.minimum_m339_fix: Retain the q16 identity prefix but mark non-beneficial entries service-ineligible and verify they always take exact bit-sparse fallback; report provisioned versus reachable PWP entries.

minimum_m339_admission_gate: Exact-SHA runtime cohort disjoint from the 32-sample calibration cohort; catalog frozen before replay.
Deterministic nearest-center value/index/distance tie rule, bit/cycle mitered end-to-end.
Identical q16/q32/q64/q128 and bit-sparse row stream with no silent filtering differences.
Finite matcher latency/II, q-pass cost, PWP address traffic, residency/cache/DMA, bank conflicts, FIFO backpressure, corrections, accumulator and commit modeled.
Capacity and bandwidth included for both candidate and baseline; report decimal MB and binary MiB explicitly.
Separate vector-work, module-cycle, energy/PPA and system claims; no inheritance of 2.0583x into any stronger level.

novelty_and_fairness_verdict.novelty: Low-to-moderate at M338: useful deterministic nested catalog construction and exact-work accounting, but not a new clustering method or hardware runtime innovation by itself.
novelty_and_fairness_verdict.fairness: Internally fair as a nested-capacity train calibration ablation. Not yet fair as a runtime accelerator comparison or against separately optimized/equal-storage Prosperity/Phi-style baselines.
novelty_and_fairness_verdict.recommended_paper_role: Supporting catalog/memory-capacity ablation behind an executable pattern-plus-correction module; not a standalone headline contribution.
